<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/pricing-card.ts -->
<!--
  A plan as a card: name, tagline, price per month, the features, a call to action and an optional slot for more
  actions. Text comes in through `labels`; the plan is data.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Plan, PricingCardLabels } from "./pricing-card.types";

  export type PricingCardProps = {
    plan: Plan;
    labels: PricingCardLabels;
    current?: boolean;
    emphasis?: "auto" | "off";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    billing?: "monthly" | "annual";
    footer?: Snippet<[Plan]>;
    onselect?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import CardDescription from "../primitives/card/card-description.svelte";
  import CardFooter from "../primitives/card/card-footer.svelte";
  import CardHeader from "../primitives/card/card-header.svelte";
  import CardTitle from "../primitives/card/card-title.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    plan,
    labels,
    current,
    emphasis = "auto",
    density = "default",
    billing = "monthly",
    footer,
    onselect,
  }: PricingCardProps = $props();
  const stand = $derived(plan.highlighted && ((emphasis as string) === "auto"));
  const yearlyOn = $derived(((billing as string) === "annual") && (plan.yearly > 0));
  const amount = $derived(yearlyOn ? plan.yearly : plan.price);
</script>

<Block
  tag="article"
  class={cn(
    "flex flex-col gap-8 bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground inset-ring inset-ring-border rounded",
    "flex h-full flex-col"
  )}
  data-slot="card"
  data-highlighted={(stand ? "true" : "false")}
  data-current={(current ? "true" : "false")}
>
  <CardHeader class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    <Box class="flex min-h-6 items-center" data-slot="badge-slot">
      {#if stand}
        <Badge variant="default" size="default">
          {labels.popular}
        </Badge>
      {/if}
    </Box>
    <CardTitle as={3}>
      {plan.name}
    </CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>
      {plan.tagline}
    </CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent class={cn("flex flex-1 flex-col", (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-2" : "gap-4"))}>
    <Group gap="2" align="baseline">
      <Title as={2} size="4xl" weight="bold">
        {#if (amount === 0)}
          {labels.free}
        {:else}
          {fmtMoney(amount, plan.currency)}
        {/if}
      </Title>
      {#if (amount > 0)}
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {(yearlyOn ? labels.perYear : labels.perMonth)}
        </Text>
      {/if}
    </Group>
    <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
      {tpl(labels.seats, plan.seats)}
    </Text>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {tpl(labels.storage, plan.storage)}
    </Text>
    <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
      {#each plan.features as feature (feature)}
        <ListItem class="flex gap-2">
          {feature}
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
    <Button
      variant={(stand ? "default" : "outline")}
      size="default"
      data-testid="plan-select"
      onclick={() => onselect?.(plan.id)}
    >
      {labels.cta}
    </Button>
    {@render footer?.(plan)}
  </CardFooter>
</Block>
